en.title: Pronouncing Nu-l in Romanian
en.summary: Learn how to pronounce nu-l smoothly as one connected sound in everyday Romanian speech.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: Two words join together into one quick beat. Listen to the phrase (nu-l văd) /nul vəd/. It means I do not see him. The middle vowel drops away completely. You say one smooth part instead of two. The voice glides through without any pause.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Start with rounded lips for (nu) /nu/. Then, quickly tap your tongue behind your front teeth. Do not make a new vowel sound. Keep your voice going strong. Say it in one quick breath. It rhymes closely with 'pool'.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: You see a hyphen between the two written parts. The full form begins with (îl) /ɨl/. The hyphen shows that the vowel drops. You read the two parts as one unit. Put your stress on the next main word.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say two separate words here. People often stop their voice at the hyphen. Never take a breath between the letters. Also, do not add an extra vowel between them. Keep the sound short, tight, and connected. Move smoothly into the next word.
